evidence.excerpt: In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation.
